package WurstExportedObjects_w3b
import ObjEditingNatives
import DestructableObjEditing

// Modified Table (contains all custom objects)

@compiletime function create_w3b_B000()
	new DestructableDefinition('B000', 'ATtc')
	..setName("Ashenvale Canopy Tree (Large)")
	..setMaximumScale(5.0)


@compiletime function create_w3b_B001()
	new DestructableDefinition('B001', 'ZTw3')
	..setName("Stone Wall (Dark)")
	..setVertexColorRed(50)
	..setVertexColorGreen(50)
	..setVertexColorBlue(50)
	..setMaximumScale(2.0)


@compiletime function create_w3b_B002()
	new DestructableDefinition('B002', 'ZTw1')
	..setName("Stone Wall (Dark)")
	..setVertexColorRed(50)
	..setVertexColorGreen(50)
	..setVertexColorBlue(50)
	..setMaximumScale(2.0)


@compiletime function create_w3b_B003()

	..setName("Stone Wall (Dark)")
	..setVertexColorRed(50)

@compiletime function create_w3b_B004()

	..setName("Stone Wall (Dark)")
	..setVertexColorRed(50)
	..setVertexColorGreen(50)
	..setVertexColorBlue(50)
	..setMaximumScale(2.0)


@compiletime function create_w3b_B005()
	new DestructableDefinition('B005', 'DTes')
	..setHitPoints(9999.0)
	// TODO no wrapper: 	..setInt("bgse", 0)
	..setTargetedAs("invulnerable")
	..setVertexColorBlue(0)
	..setVertexColorGreen(120)
	..setVertexColorRed(250)
	..setMaximumScale(2.0)
	..setMinimumScale(0.5)
	..setName("Silithid Egg Sack")
	// TODO no wrapper: 	..setReal("bgsc", 1.0)


@compiletime function create_w3b_B006()
	new DestructableDefinition('B006', 'LOcg')
	..setName("Gong")
	..setModel("war3mapImported\\ImprovedGong.mdl")
	..setMaximumScale(4.0)


@compiletime function create_w3b_B007()
	new DestructableDefinition('B007', 'LTbs')
	..setName("Custom Wall")
	..setModel("war3mapImported\\Wooden Log Wall.mdl")
	..setMaximumScale(3.0)


@compiletime function create_w3b_B008()
	new DestructableDefinition('B008', 'LTbs')
	..setTargetedAs("")
	// TODO no wrapper: 	..setInt("bgse", 0)
	// TODO no wrapper: 	..setInt("bfvi", 1)
	..setName("ShadowCanopy")
	// TODO no wrapper: 	..setString("bgpm", "Abilities\\Spells\\Orc\\AncestralSpirit\\AncestralSpiritCaster.mdl")
	..setVertexColorBlue(0)
	..setVertexColorRed(0)
	..setVertexColorGreen(0)
	..setShadow("ShadowAncientofLore")
	..setPath("")
	..setModel("Abilities\\Weapons\\ChimaeraLightningMissile\\ChimaeraLightningMissile.mdl")
	// TODO no wrapper: 	..setInt("buch", 1)
	..setFixedRotation(90.0)
	..setMinimumScale(1.0)
	..setMaximumScale(1.0)
